server {
	listen 8443 ssl;
	listen 127.0.0.1:8080;
	server_name API.Example.org "~^api-(?<region>[a-z]+)\.example\.org$";
	ssl_certificate "/etc/nginx/ssl/api.example.org.pem";
	ssl_certificate_key "/etc/nginx/ssl/api.example.org.key";

	location / {
		root /srv/api/public;
		fastcgi_pass php82;
		include fastcgi_params;
	}
}
